_comment: Editorial content for BNWM. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of the Bannu mill exists, and a generic textile photograph would imply it is theirs.
description: Bannu Woollen Mills Limited is a wool textile manufacturer based at D.I. Khan Road in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It describes itself as a textile composite company specialising in wool spinning, weaving and finishing, and its stated mission is to be a lead producer of quality woollen and blended fabrics, blankets and shawls.
headOffice: D.I. Khan Road, Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
